## [1.14.0](https://github.com/hxreborn/morphe-patches/compare/v1.13.0...v1.14.0) (2026-08-30)

### Bug Fixes

* **Cx File Explorer - Dark theme:** darken the file operation progress dialog ([f072429](https://github.com/hxreborn/morphe-patches/commit/f072429435c5d77774e4d5a0cd6eaaecf2104bff))

### New Features

* **All-In-One Calculator - GmsCore support:** sign in through GmsCore ([29267f9](https://github.com/hxreborn/morphe-patches/commit/29267f9bd56162f920bd858a15da0bf296a7f11b))
* **RateGlance - Remove pairip protection:** drop the Play Integrity license check ([401f975](https://github.com/hxreborn/morphe-patches/commit/401f975e428c56a1ebe6b8cfa61a9a91cecc9339))
* **RateGlance - Unlock premium:** unlock alerts widgets and full rate history ([366a1f3](https://github.com/hxreborn/morphe-patches/commit/366a1f3d92560f23b5692c6bc7ec29271030007f))

patches.name: AMOLED dark theme
patches.description: Replaces the dark theme background with pure black.

patches.name: GmsCore support
patches.description: Signs in through GmsCore instead of Google Play Services. Requires GmsCore to be installed.

patches.name: Remove pairip protection
patches.description: Removes the Play Integrity protection that crashes a patched install on startup and sends it to Google Play. Background receivers the protection virtualized stop running.

patches.name: Unlock premium
patches.description: Grants the pro entitlement, which removes the ads and the paywalled tools.

patches.name: Unlock premium
patches.description: Unlocks running and logging workouts, progress tracking and personal records (AI workout generation is not included).

patches.name: Unlock premium
patches.description: Unlocks all premium features.

patches.name: AMOLED dark theme
patches.description: Replaces the dark theme background with pure black.

patches.name: Hide upgrade upselling
patches.description: Hides the top-bar upgrade button and promotional sidebar rows.

patches.name: Remove 'Sent from' signature
patches.description: Removes the 'Sent from Proton Mail' signature from emails.

patches.name: Remove free accounts limit
patches.description: Removes the limit for maximum free accounts logged in.

patches.name: Spoof signature
patches.description: Restores push notifications by spoofing the original app signature.

patches.name: Unlock custom time picker
patches.description: Enables picking a custom date and time when snoozing conversations and scheduling messages.

patches.name: Hide membership upselling
patches.description: Hides the membership promotion on the Home screen and the free trial bottom sheet.

patches.name: Open Library on launch
patches.description: Opens the Library tab instead of Home on launch. Applies only while signed in.

patches.name: AMOLED dark theme
patches.description: Adds a pure black option to the dark theme.

patches.name: Dark theme
patches.description: Renders the app's dark theme and adds it to the settings.

patches.name: Unlock premium
patches.description: Unlocks premium and removes ads.

patches.name: Hide ads
patches.description: Removes promoted listings and the "with Ads" label from search results.

patches.name: Hide ads
patches.description: Disables banner, interstitial, and native ads.

patches.name: AMOLED dark theme
patches.description: Replaces the dark theme background with pure black. Disables over-the-air updates that would restore the original background.

patches.name: AMOLED dark theme
patches.description: Replaces the dark theme background with pure black.

patches.name: Unlock premium
patches.description: Unlocks ad removal, light theme, custom images, list view types, quick ratings, and transparent widgets. The News feed is not included.

patches.name: Unlock premium
patches.description: Unlocks all premium features.

patches.name: Disable tracking
patches.description: Disables analytics and crash reporting.

patches.name: Unlock premium
patches.description: Unlocks all premium features.

patches.name: Remove pairip protection
patches.description: Removes the Play Integrity license check.

patches.name: Unlock premium
patches.description: Unlocks all premium features.

patches.name: Unlock pro
patches.description: Unlocks task lists, callouts, app lock, and the notebook, tag, colour and reminder limits. Requires a signed-in account. The server still enforces storage, attachment size, monographs and SMS 2FA.

patches.name: Hide ads
patches.description: Removes the adverts shown between search results.

patches.name: Remove nags
patches.description: Removes the rate this app dialog and the promotional dialogs shown on startup.

patches.name: Hide ads
patches.description: Adds an option to hide banner, interstitial, app-open and rewarded ads.

patches.name: Inspect AI requests
patches.description: Shows the network calls an AI tool makes, such as HTTP requests and Firebase uploads, and keeps a log, so you can watch your photo fly to China or the US.

patches.name: Show AI progress
patches.description: Reads the current stage off the real network activity instead of the fake progress bar InShot ships.

patches.name: Speed up AI tools
patches.description: Shortens the AI tool wait by polling for the result more often and uploading the photo in larger chunks.

patches.name: Spoof iOS platform
patches.description: Reports the AI requests as coming from the iOS app, so the server does not ask for a Play Integrity token. Required for the AI tools on any device that passes Play Integrity.

patches.name: Spoof signature
patches.description: Spoofs the original app signature and disables the pairip client-side license check. Required: the app does not start without it.

patches.name: Unlock premium
patches.description: Adds an option to unlock the pro tools, remove the export watermark and hide the upgrade prompts.

patches.name: Bypass signature check
patches.description: Removes the modified-version warning and restores address search and auto-routing.

patches.name: Unlock full version
patches.description: Unlocks the Off-Road Explorer features gated behind activation.
